comparison.objective: Stand a tipped glue gun with its hot nozzle off the mat; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard-aware reorientation and stable placement versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammer impact, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Glue gun stands with nozzle clear of the mat versus four clean, contained fractures and retained coils. Clearance/stability rubric is absent.
comparison.reason: The tested outcome is safe object posture, not controlled material separation.
